text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Phew! Ate my fill again this time!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Incredible... It was even more delicious than during the recital...! Rice might have teared up a little bit...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
H-How terrifying...!
Just how much more delicious can we possibly become...?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. I got so much inspiration from everyone else's cooking, too...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I've got nutrition studies down pat, after all~
So my training's gonna be super effective too~!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, magnificent!
A dish that truly combines both form and substance!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, pardon me!
I just wanted to express my gratitude once again for the recital the other day.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "Thanks to you all, the students' awareness of nutrition has improved even further! You have my sincere gratitude!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...It might be time to start thinking about it.
The next stage, that is—"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Anyway! Thanks for the meal today!
Keep up the hard work!"
